serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: Where have you been?! Dumbass!
You: W-What is it?
Landlord: Did you forget? Today is the rent day! I spent my whole afternoon knocking on your door!
You: Sorry about that. I was busy with other things.
Landlord: And why would I care about that?!
You: I’m really sorry, Here’s the money.
